headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend Systems & Data Platforms
summary: Backend engineer with 8+ years building data platforms and payment services on AWS. Built a billing platform of 6 services that handles 3M+ payment events per day and moves ledger data into a shared warehouse for analytics teams. Led a migration of 40 nightly batch jobs to Step Functions that cut compute costs by 35%. Owns on-call for 9 production services and mentors 4 engineers through design and code reviews.

bullets.text: Designed and built a billing platform of 6 services that processes 3M+ payment events per day with Python and PostgreSQL.
Cut P99 API latency from 900ms to 250ms by adding a Redis cache and rewriting 12 slow SQL queries.
Led a migration of 40 nightly batch jobs to AWS Step Functions, cutting compute costs by 35% and failed runs by 80%.
Run on-call for 9 production services with CloudWatch alarms on 60+ metrics and a weekly incident review.
Mentor 4 engineers through design reviews and code reviews, and wrote the team's API design guide.
Split a monolithic invoicing service into 4 independently deployable services on Docker and Kubernetes.
Built a Kafka event pipeline that moves 500K ledger records per hour into a Redshift warehouse for 5 analytics teams.
Added contract tests and a CI/CD pipeline in GitHub Actions, raising test coverage from 55% to 90%.
Shipped a REST API for partner refunds used by 30+ merchants within the first quarter.
Built a TypeScript and React dashboard for finance operations used by 120 staff each week.
Automated a monthly reconciliation report in Python, saving 20 hours of manual work per month.
Wrote data validation checks that caught 15 billing errors before customer invoices were sent.
Moved 8 internal reports from spreadsheets to a shared SQL reporting database with daily refresh jobs.
Built a recipe planner app as a solo project with a NestJS API and a Supabase (PostgreSQL) database, now used by 300+ people.
Built a bridge that forwards team chat threads to email for 2 volunteer groups, running on Cloudflare Workers.
Added automated tests and CI on GitHub Actions that run in under 3 minutes.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
